body: Published https://okemily.com/blog/the-custody-of-a-podcast-promptoverse-stats/ (author: Tyler) -- podcast-transcript-format blog post using real, live-queried Prompt-o-verse stats (285 nodes, 53 subjects, 34 styles, 78/207 historical/surreal split, Medusa leading at 26 gens, 'outer space' leading styles at 19, 9-subject long tail, timeline burst+lull pattern, first-ever variant and first-ever style hybrid both at sample size 1) as material for the just_a_duck.md garage cast (Duck/Unicorn/Ghost/Frog/Tree/Pizza) to riff on in character. Closes S179-05.
title: Blog: Tyler and the garage gang deep-dive Prompt-o-verse stats
